description: This file defines the interface for block source operations used for reading reftables, including functions for closing, reading data, getting size, releasing data, and creating in-memory sources.

methods.name: block_source_close
methods.description: Closes the block source and releases its associated resources.

methods.name: block_source_read_data
methods.description: Reads a block of data from the source at a specified offset.

methods.name: block_source_size
methods.description: Returns the total size of the underlying resource.

methods.name: block_source_release_data
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a data block.

methods.name: block_source_from_buf
methods.description: Creates an in-memory block source from a buffer.
